checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Slides read Slow Sunday, Coffee first, Stay a little longer; last word's final 'r' is slightly glitchy but legible.
Same cream background, brown serif, caramel accents.
Cup and croissant, pour-over kettle, armchair with table and book.
All text is well inside the margins and legible.

exact_text.read_as: Stay a little longer (final 'r' has a slight artefact)

faults.what: The final 'r' of 'longer' on slide 3 is malformed, with a smudgy italic-looking flourish.
Slide 3's text is smaller and the illustration style is a little more detailed and painterly than the others.
Content is small with a lot of empty margin, and resolution is low at 640px.

summary: Three cohesive cream-and-brown café slides with correct text and fitting illustrations; the only real flaw is a slightly glitchy final 'r' in 'longer' on slide 3.
